title: Pawn of Prophecy
author: David Eddings
summary: A farm boy's quiet life ends when a storyteller and an aunt take him on a chase across the kingdoms after a stolen magical orb. His companions are an odd and bickering lot.
readIf: you want a breezy, humorous fantasy with a cast of comfortable, bickering travellers.
skipIf: you want surprises; it follows the standard farm-boy quest closely and is just the start of a longer series.

pairings.reason: Another farm-boy-to-hero series with a mentor figure and a growing party.
A more serious and sprawling fantasy that starts in a similar way but goes much further.
Another old-school quest with a reluctant hero and a band of unlikely companions.
